stem: Perthes disease is best defined as which condition affecting the femoral head?
explanation: Idiopathic avascular necrosis is the correct definition of Perthes disease, which is a childhood loss of blood supply to the femoral head causing bone death without an identified cause.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because Perthes disease is idiopathic avascular necrosis of the femoral head.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because septic arthritis is an infection of a joint, not avascular necrosis of bone.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because slipped capital femoral epiphysis is displacement through the growth plate, not idiopathic bone necrosis.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because developmental dysplasia of the hip is abnormal hip joint formation, not femoral head avascular necrosis.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because transient synovitis is a self-limiting inflammation of the hip synovium, not bone death.

source.hint: Focus on the vascular and idiopathic nature of the bone death described in the source.
